# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by `statescope docs` from data/schema/, data/vocab/, and db/schema.sql. Edit those files and regenerate; changes made here are overwritten. -->

Every field of every record type, the controlled vocabularies they draw on, and the tables of the built database.

## Records

Field paths use `a.b` for a field of an object and `a[].b` for a field of each item in a list.

### Legislation

A bill or resolution in a state legislature or Congress. Stored at data/legislation/{jurisdiction}/{session}/{bill-slug}.yaml. Status is not stored: it is derived from the dated actions at build time.

File: `data/legislation/{jurisdiction}/{session}/{bill-slug}.yaml`

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | {jurisdiction}-{session}-{bill-slug}, e.g. 'us-tx-2025-hb-1481'. Must match the file path. | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |
| `jurisdiction` | string | yes | 'us' for federal, 'us-xx' for a state or DC (lowercase USPS code). | id of a jurisdiction record; pattern `^us(-[a-z]{2})?$` |
| `session` | string | yes | Session identifier listed under sessions in data/jurisdictions/{jurisdiction}.yaml. | a session identifier in the jurisdiction's file |
| `identifier` | string | yes | Official bill number as written by the legislature, e.g. 'HB 1481', 'H.R. 610'. |  |
| `title` | string | yes | Official or short title. |  |
| `classification` | string | yes |  | code from [legislation_classifications](#legislation_classifications) |
| `education_levels` | list of strings | yes |  | code from [education_levels](#education_levels) |
| `topics` | list of strings | yes |  | code from [topics](#topics) |
| `summary` | string | yes | Plain-language summary written for a general audience. |  |
| `abstract` | string |  | Official digest or synopsis, verbatim, when one exists. |  |
| `provisions` | list of objects |  |  |  |
| `provisions[].type` | string | yes |  | code from [provision_types](#provision_types) |
| `provisions[].description` | string | yes | Plain-language statement of what this provision does. |  |
| `provisions[].education_levels` | list of strings |  |  | code from [education_levels](#education_levels) |
| `provisions[].citation` | object | yes | Points a specific claim at the place in a source that supports it. |  |
| `provisions[].citation.source_url` | URL | yes |  |  |
| `provisions[].citation.locator` | string |  | Section, page, or paragraph, e.g. 'Sec. 3(b)' or 'p. 14'. |  |
| `provisions[].citation.quote` | string |  | Short verbatim excerpt supporting the claim. | at most 600 characters |
| `sponsors` | list of objects |  |  |  |
| `sponsors[].name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `sponsors[].classification` | string |  | Whether the sponsor is a legislator or a committee. Omitted means person. | `person`, `committee` |
| `sponsors[].primary` | boolean | yes |  |  |
| `sponsors[].party` | string |  |  |  |
| `sponsors[].chamber` | string |  |  | `lower`, `upper` |
| `sponsors[].openstates_person_id` | string |  |  |  |
| `actions` | list of objects | yes | Chronological legislative history, at least the introduction. Each action must be one the legislature recorded, dated no later than the day it is entered. Failure at the end of a session is derived from the session's end_date, so it is not entered as an action. |  |
| `actions[].date` | date, `YYYY-MM-DD` | yes | ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). |  |
| `actions[].description` | string | yes | Action text as recorded by the legislature. |  |
| `actions[].actor` | string |  |  | code from [action_actors](#action_actors) |
| `actions[].classification` | list of strings | yes |  | code from [action_classifications](#action_classifications) |
| `versions` | list of objects |  |  |  |
| `versions[].note` | string | yes | e.g. 'Introduced', 'Engrossed', 'Enrolled', 'Chaptered'. |  |
| `versions[].date` | date, `YYYY-MM-DD` |  | ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). |  |
| `versions[].url` | URL | yes |  |  |
| `versions[].archived_url` | URL |  |  |  |
| `versions[].media_type` | string |  |  |  |
| `session_law` | string |  | Chapter or public act number once enacted, e.g. 'Public Act 104-0001'. |  |
| `related` | list of strings |  | IDs of related records (companion bills, guidance it produced, etc.). | id of any record; pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |
| `external_ids` | object |  | Identifiers for this record in upstream systems. |  |
| `external_ids.legiscan_bill_id` | integer |  |  |  |
| `external_ids.openstates_id` | string |  |  |  |
| `external_ids.congress_gov` | string |  | e.g. '119/hr/610' |  |
| `external_ids.federal_register_document_number` | string |  |  |  |
| `external_ids.doi` | string |  |  |  |
| `external_ids.openalex_id` | string |  |  |  |
| `sources` | list of objects | yes |  |  |
| `sources[].url` | URL | yes |  |  |
| `sources[].title` | string |  |  |  |
| `sources[].publisher` | string |  |  |  |
| `sources[].kind` | string | yes |  | code from [source_kinds](#source_kinds) |
| `sources[].accessed` | date, `YYYY-MM-DD` | yes | Date the source was last retrieved. |  |
| `sources[].archived_url` | URL |  | Permanent archive copy, usually the Wayback Machine. |  |
| `verification` | object | yes |  |  |
| `verification.status` | string | yes |  | code from [verification_statuses](#verification_statuses) |
| `verification.last_verified` | date, `YYYY-MM-DD` |  | ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). |  |
| `verification.method` | string |  | How verification was done, e.g. 'legiscan-text', 'manual'. |  |
| `verification.notes` | string |  |  |  |

### Policy document

Non-legislative policy issued by an agency, university system, or accreditor: guidance, frameworks, binding policy, toolkits, statements, task-force reports. Stored at data/documents/{jurisdiction}/{slug}.yaml.

File: `data/documents/{jurisdiction}/{slug}.yaml`

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | {jurisdiction}-{slug}, e.g. 'us-ca-cde-learning-with-ai'. Must match the file path. | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |
| `jurisdiction` | string | yes | 'us' for federal, 'us-xx' for a state or DC (lowercase USPS code). | id of a jurisdiction record; pattern `^us(-[a-z]{2})?$` |
| `issuer` | string | yes | Organization ID from data/organizations/. | id of a organization record |
| `title` | string | yes |  |  |
| `classification` | string | yes |  | code from [document_classifications](#document_classifications) |
| `status` | string | yes |  | code from [document_statuses](#document_statuses) |
| `education_levels` | list of strings | yes |  | code from [education_levels](#education_levels) |
| `topics` | list of strings | yes |  | code from [topics](#topics) |
| `summary` | string | yes |  |  |
| `published` | date, `YYYY`, `YYYY-MM`, or `YYYY-MM-DD` |  | Date the document was first issued, when the document or its issuer gives it. |  |
| `updated` | date, `YYYY`, `YYYY-MM`, or `YYYY-MM-DD` |  | Date of the current edition or last update, as shown by the issuer. |  |
| `version` | string |  | Edition or version number the issuer gives the current text, e.g. '3.0'. |  |
| `effective` | date, `YYYY-MM-DD` |  | Date binding policy takes effect. |  |
| `undated` | boolean |  | True when neither the document nor its issuer gives a date; published and updated are then left out rather than estimated. |  |
| `provisions` | list of objects |  |  |  |
| `provisions[].type` | string | yes |  | code from [provision_types](#provision_types) |
| `provisions[].description` | string | yes | Plain-language statement of what this provision does. |  |
| `provisions[].education_levels` | list of strings |  |  | code from [education_levels](#education_levels) |
| `provisions[].citation` | object | yes | Points a specific claim at the place in a source that supports it. |  |
| `provisions[].citation.source_url` | URL | yes |  |  |
| `provisions[].citation.locator` | string |  | Section, page, or paragraph, e.g. 'Sec. 3(b)' or 'p. 14'. |  |
| `provisions[].citation.quote` | string |  | Short verbatim excerpt supporting the claim. | at most 600 characters |
| `revisions` | list of objects |  | Observed versions of the document, newest last. Populated by the change watcher. |  |
| `revisions[].observed` | date, `YYYY-MM-DD` | yes | ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). |  |
| `revisions[].url` | URL | yes |  |  |
| `revisions[].archived_url` | URL |  |  |  |
| `revisions[].sha256` | string |  | Hash of the normalized extracted text. | pattern `^[a-f0-9]{64}$` |
| `revisions[].note` | string |  |  |  |
| `superseded_by` | string |  | Stable identifier. Never reused or changed once published. | id of a document record; pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |
| `authorized_by` | string |  | Legislation or executive action that required this document. | id of any record; pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |
| `related` | list of strings |  |  | id of any record; pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |
| `sources` | list of objects | yes |  |  |
| `sources[].url` | URL | yes |  |  |
| `sources[].title` | string |  |  |  |
| `sources[].publisher` | string |  |  |  |
| `sources[].kind` | string | yes |  | code from [source_kinds](#source_kinds) |
| `sources[].accessed` | date, `YYYY-MM-DD` | yes | Date the source was last retrieved. |  |
| `sources[].archived_url` | URL |  | Permanent archive copy, usually the Wayback Machine. |  |
| `verification` | object | yes |  |  |
| `verification.status` | string | yes |  | code from [verification_statuses](#verification_statuses) |
| `verification.last_verified` | date, `YYYY-MM-DD` |  | ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). |  |
| `verification.method` | string |  | How verification was done, e.g. 'legiscan-text', 'manual'. |  |
| `verification.notes` | string |  |  |  |

### Research item

A study, report, brief, or survey on AI in education. Stored at data/research/{year}/{slug}.yaml.

File: `data/research/{year}/{slug}.yaml`

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | {year}-{slug}. Must match the file path. | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |
| `title` | string | yes |  |  |
| `authors` | list of strings | yes |  |  |
| `publisher` | string | yes | Journal or publishing organization. |  |
| `published` | date, `YYYY`, `YYYY-MM`, or `YYYY-MM-DD` | yes | ISO 8601 date with optional month and day, for sources that publish only a year or month. |  |
| `classification` | string | yes |  | code from [research_classifications](#research_classifications) |
| `education_levels` | list of strings | yes |  | code from [education_levels](#education_levels) |
| `topics` | list of strings | yes |  | code from [topics](#topics) |
| `summary` | string | yes | What was studied, how, and what was found, in plain language. |  |
| `key_findings` | list of objects |  |  |  |

| `key_findings[].citation` | object | yes | Points a specific claim at the place in a source that supports it. |  |

| `methods` | string |  | Design and sample, e.g. 'RCT, n=1,200 high school students, 3 states'. |  |

### Organization

A body that issues policy: legislatures, governors' offices, state K-12 and higher-ed agencies, university systems, accreditors, federal agencies. Stored at data/organizations/{id}.yaml.

File: `data/organizations/{id}.yaml`

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | e.g. 'us-ca-cde', 'us-ed', 'sacscoc'. | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `abbreviation` | string |  |  |  |
| `classification` | string | yes |  | code from [organization_classifications](#organization_classifications) |
| `jurisdiction` | string |  | Omitted for bodies that span states, such as regional accreditors. | id of a jurisdiction record; pattern `^us(-[a-z]{2})?$` |
| `education_levels` | list of strings |  |  | code from [education_levels](#education_levels) |
| `url` | URL | yes |  |  |
| `watch_urls` | list of URLs |  | Pages the change watcher monitors for new or revised AI policy. |  |

### Jurisdiction

The United States or one of the 50 states and DC. Stored at data/jurisdictions/{id}.yaml.

File: `data/jurisdictions/{id}.yaml`

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | 'us' for federal, 'us-xx' for a state or DC (lowercase USPS code). | id of a jurisdiction record; pattern `^us(-[a-z]{2})?$` |
| `ocd_id` | string | yes | Open Civic Data division identifier. | pattern `^ocd-division/country:us(/(state\|district):[a-z]{2})?$` |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `abbreviation` | string | yes |  | pattern `^[A-Z]{2}$\|^US$` |
| `classification` | string | yes |  | `country`, `state`, `district` |
| `fips` | string |  |  | pattern `^\d{2}$` |
| `region` | string |  |  | `Northeast`, `Southeast`, `Midwest`, `Southwest`, `West` |
| `legislature_url` | URL |  |  |  |
| `sessions` | list of objects |  |  |  |
| `sessions[].identifier` | string | yes | Used in legislation IDs and paths, e.g. '2025', '2025-2026', '119'. |  |
| `sessions[].name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `sessions[].classification` | string |  |  | `primary`, `special` |
| `sessions[].start_date` | date, `YYYY-MM-DD` | yes | ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). |  |
| `sessions[].end_date` | date, `YYYY-MM-DD` |  | Last day of the session. Measures short of final passage by this date are derived as failed. |  |
| `sessions[].legiscan_session_id` | integer |  |  |  |
| `sessions[].sources` | list of objects |  | Official sources for the session's dates. |  |
| `sessions[].sources[].url` | URL | yes |  |  |
| `sessions[].sources[].title` | string |  |  |  |
| `sessions[].sources[].publisher` | string |  |  |  |
| `sessions[].sources[].kind` | string | yes |  | code from [source_kinds](#source_kinds) |
| `sessions[].sources[].accessed` | date, `YYYY-MM-DD` | yes | Date the source was last retrieved. |  |
| `sessions[].sources[].archived_url` | URL |  | Permanent archive copy, usually the Wayback Machine. |  |

## Vocabularies

Fields marked with a vocabulary take one of its codes. The validator rejects any other value. Codes are permanent; labels may be reworded.

### topics

From `data/vocab/topics.yaml`.

| Code | Name | Description | Education levels |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ai-literacy` | AI Literacy | Teaching students and educators what AI is, how it works, and its limits and risks. | k12, postsecondary |
| `curriculum-standards` | Curriculum & Standards | Integrating AI into curriculum frameworks, content standards, or course requirements. | k12, postsecondary |
| `instructional-use` | Instructional Use | Rules and guidance for using AI tools in teaching and learning. | k12, postsecondary |
| `educator-training` | Educator Training | Professional development, preparation, or licensure requirements for teachers and faculty on AI. | k12, postsecondary |
| `local-policy-requirement` | Local Policy Requirement | Requires districts, schools, or institutions to adopt their own AI use policy. | k12, postsecondary |
| `academic-integrity` | Academic Integrity | AI use by students in coursework, plagiarism, and detection. | k12, postsecondary |
| `assessment` | Assessment | AI in testing, grading, proctoring, and evaluation of students. | k12, postsecondary |
| `student-privacy` | Student Privacy | Protecting student personal information processed by AI systems. | k12, postsecondary |
| `data-governance` | Data Governance | Frameworks for collecting, sharing, retaining, and securing education data used by AI. | k12, postsecondary |
| `procurement` | Procurement & Vendors | Purchasing, vetting, and contracting for AI-powered education technology. | k12, postsecondary |
| `safety-wellbeing` | Student Safety & Wellbeing | Chatbots and minors, mental health, age-appropriateness, and online safety in school settings. | k12, postsecondary |
| `synthetic-media` | Deepfakes & Synthetic Media | AI-generated images, audio, or video involving students or staff, including harassment and discipline. | k12, postsecondary |
| `equity-access` | Equity & Access | Equitable access to AI tools and instruction; bias and disparate impact. | k12, postsecondary |
| `task-force` | Task Forces & Study | Commissions, working groups, councils, or studies on AI in education. | k12, postsecondary |
| `workforce` | Workforce & Careers | Preparing students for AI-affected careers; AI pathways, certificates, and programs. | k12, postsecondary |
| `funding` | Funding & Grants | Appropriations, grants, or pilot programs for AI in education. | k12, postsecondary |
| `research` | Research | Funding or conducting research on AI in education. | k12, postsecondary |
| `admissions` | Admissions & Enrollment | AI in admissions decisions, applications, and enrollment management. | postsecondary |
| `research-integrity` | Research Integrity | AI use in academic research, publication, and grant writing. | postsecondary |
| `institutional-operations` | Institutional Operations | AI use in administration, advising, student services, and institutional decision-making. | k12, postsecondary |
| `employment-evaluation` | Staff Employment & Evaluation | AI in hiring, evaluating, supervising, or replacing teachers, faculty, and staff. | k12, postsecondary |

### provision_types

From `data/vocab/provision-types.yaml`.

| Code | Name | Topic | Education levels |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requires-ai-literacy-instruction` | Requires AI literacy instruction | `ai-literacy` | k12, postsecondary |
| `ai-in-standards` | Adds AI to content standards or frameworks | `curriculum-standards` | k12 |
| `ai-course-or-graduation-requirement` | Creates an AI course or graduation requirement | `curriculum-standards` | k12, postsecondary |

| `issues-model-policy` | Directs an agency to issue guidance or a model policy | `local-policy-requirement` | k12, postsecondary |
| `educator-pd-requirement` | Requires or funds educator AI professional development | `educator-training` | k12, postsecondary |
| `educator-prep-requirement` | Adds AI to educator preparation or licensure | `educator-training` | k12, postsecondary |
| `restricts-student-data-use` | Restricts AI vendors' use of student data | `student-privacy` | k12, postsecondary |
| `prohibits-ai-replacing-educators` | Prohibits AI from replacing licensed educators | `instructional-use` | k12, postsecondary |
| `limits-ai-instructional-use` | Limits or bans AI tools in instruction | `instructional-use` | k12, postsecondary |
| `academic-integrity-rules` | Sets academic integrity rules for AI use | `academic-integrity` | k12, postsecondary |
| `regulates-ai-assessment` | Regulates AI in grading, testing, or proctoring | `assessment` | k12, postsecondary |
| `procurement-standards` | Sets procurement or vetting standards for AI tools | `procurement` | k12, postsecondary |
| `addresses-deepfakes` | Addresses deepfakes involving students or staff | `synthetic-media` | k12, postsecondary |
| `chatbot-minor-protections` | Protections for minors using AI chatbots | `safety-wellbeing` | k12 |
| `creates-task-force` | Creates a task force, council, or study | `task-force` | k12, postsecondary |
| `appropriates-funding` | Appropriates funding, creates a grant program, or sets grant priorities | `funding` | k12, postsecondary |
| `ai-workforce-program` | Creates an AI workforce, pathway, or credential program | `workforce` | k12, postsecondary |
| `ai-in-admissions` | Regulates AI in admissions decisions | `admissions` | postsecondary |
| `requires-disclosure` | Requires disclosure of AI use to students or families | `instructional-use` | k12, postsecondary |
| `bias-or-equity-requirement` | Requires bias review or equitable access | `equity-access` | k12, postsecondary |

## Database

`statescope build` writes these tables to `build/statescope.db`, and one CSV and Parquet file per table. Definitions are in `db/schema.sql`.

### `topics`

Subject topics, from data/vocab/topics.yaml.

| Column | Type | Description | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | TEXT | Stable topic code, e.g. 'ai-literacy'. |  |
| `name` | TEXT | Display name. |  |
| `description` | TEXT | What the topic covers. |  |
| `position` | INTEGER | 1-based order in topics.yaml. Codes are only appended, so this is also a stable integer key. |  |
| `k12` | INTEGER | 1 if the topic applies to K-12. |  |
| `postsecondary` | INTEGER | 1 if the topic applies to higher education. |  |

### `provision_types`

Provision types: the columns of the cross-state comparison grid, from data/vocab/provision-types.yaml.

| Column | Type | Description | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | TEXT | Stable provision type code, e.g. 'requires-local-ai-policy'. |  |
| `name` | TEXT | Display name. |  |
| `topic` | TEXT | Topic the provision type falls under. |  |
| `position` | INTEGER | 1-based order in provision-types.yaml. |  |
| `k12` | INTEGER | 1 if the provision type applies to K-12. |  |
| `postsecondary` | INTEGER | 1 if the provision type applies to higher education. |  |

### `records`

Every record in data/, so tables that can point at any record type have a real foreign key.

| Column | Type | Description | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | Record id; matches the file path. |  |
| `record_type` | TEXT | Kind of record. | `jurisdiction`, `organization`, `legislation`, `document`, `executive-action`, `research` |
| `path` | TEXT | Source file, relative to the repository root. |  |
| `num_id` | INTEGER | Integer alias derived from a hash of id: stable across builds, for clients that need numeric keys. |  |

### `jurisdictions`

The United States, the 50 states, and DC.

| Column | Type | Description | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | 'us' for federal, 'us-xx' for a state or DC. |  |
| `ocd_id` | TEXT | Open Civic Data division identifier. |  |
| `name` | TEXT | Full name. |  |
| `abbreviation` | TEXT | USPS code, or 'US'. |  |
| `classification` | TEXT | Kind of jurisdiction. | `country`, `state`, `district` |
| `fips` | TEXT | Two-digit FIPS state code. |  |
| `region` | TEXT | Census-style region. | `Northeast`, `Southeast`, `Midwest`, `Southwest`, `West` |
| `legislature_url` | TEXT | Legislature or Congress website. |  |

Legislative sessions, from the sessions list in each jurisdiction file.

| `name` | TEXT | Display name. |  |
| `classification` | TEXT | Regular or special session. | `primary`, `special` |
| `start_date` | TEXT | First day of the session. |  |
| `end_date` | TEXT | Last day of the session; bills short of final passage after this date are failed. |  |
| `legiscan_session_id` | INTEGER | LegiScan session id. |  |

Sources cited for each session's dates.

| Column | Type | Description | Allowed values |

### `legislation`

Bills and resolutions. `status` and the dates beside it are derived from legislation_actions.

| Column | Type | Description | Allowed values |

| `jurisdiction` | TEXT | Jurisdiction. |  |

| `identifier` | TEXT | Official bill number, e.g. 'HB 1481'. |  |
| `title` | TEXT | Official or short title. |  |
| `classification` | TEXT | Kind of measure. | `bill`, `resolution`, `joint-resolution`, `concurrent-resolution`, `constitutional-amendment`, `appropriation` |
| `summary` | TEXT | Plain-language summary. |  |
| `abstract` | TEXT | Official digest, verbatim. |  |
| `session_law` | TEXT | Chapter or public act number once enacted. |  |
| `status` | TEXT | Derived from the actions at build time. | `introduced`, `in-committee`, `passed-chamber`, `passed-legislature`, `enacted`, `vetoed`, `failed` |
| `status_date` | TEXT | Date of the action that set the status; NULL when the session ending did. |  |
| `introduced_date` | TEXT | Date of the first action. |  |
| `enacted_date` | TEXT | Date the bill was signed or became law. |  |
| `last_action_date` | TEXT | Date of the most recent action. |  |
| `verification_status` | TEXT | How the record was checked. | `editor-reviewed`, `machine-verified`, `unverified` |

### Views

| View | Description |
|---|---|
| `v_policies` | Legislation, documents, and executive actions in one shape. `is_current` is 1 for enacted legislation, current documents, and active executive actions. `date` is the first action for legislation, the current edition for documents (updated, else published; NULL when undated), and the signing date for executive actions. |
| `v_provision_grid` | One row per jurisdiction and provision type, including pairs with no provisions, for building the comparison grid. |
| `v_policies_legacy` | v_policies in the column names and status vocabulary that the web app and the chat API were written against. |
| `v_states_legacy` | States and DC with the policy summary the map colors by, in the web app's vocabulary. |
